title: The Unicode Standard, Version 17.0, Chapter 7, Section 7.6.1 Armenian
scope: Armenian punctuation code points and technical semantics, including tonal-mark placement; for hyphens, U+002D HYPHEN-MINUS or U+2010 HYPHEN represents word joining, versus U+058A ARMENIAN HYPHEN for end-of-line word splitting; not Armenian inflection grammar, a rule for quoted foreign titles, or an editorial preference between U+002D and U+2010.
provenance: Direct official versioned standard; the U+002D, U+2010, and U+058A role descriptions were inspected on 2026-08-13.
